summary.text: PET is polyethylene terephthalate. Makers sell it for protective parts, bumpers and covers and for large objects with fine detail, and they stress its low tendency to warp. Its glass transition is 70 °C. On the H2C it prints at 240⁠–⁠250 °C, and some sheets say no heated chamber is needed.

claim.text: PET HIGH SPEED PRO offers increased flexibility and impact resistance , allowing printed parts to withstand bending, deformation and sudden mechanical loads more effectively.

items.text: Developed for high-speed 3D printing
PET HIGH SPEED PRO is designed for fast and reliable material extrusion .
Thanks to its wide processing window , the material is suitable for both modern high-speed 3D printers and conventional printing systems.
This makes it an excellent choice for semi-rigid applications and hard-shell components where both stability and impact resistance are important.
The combination of easy processing, minimal warping and a wide processing window makes PET HIGH SPEED PRO suitable for a broad range of printers and applications.
This makes it particularly suitable for applications where both performance and appearance are important.

Potential applications include hard-shell parts, protective covers, enclosures, lampshades, vases, decorative objects and functional components that require toughness, dimensional stability and a premium surface finish.
Particularly suitable for: Hard-shell parts, protective components, lampshades, vases, enclosures and high-speed functional printing.
PET HIGH SPEED PRO Clear is a high-performance filament developed for fast and reliable 3D printing of tough functional parts.
Its wide processing window and suitability for high printing speeds make it an excellent choice for hard-shell parts, lampshades, vases and demanding functional components.
PET HIGH SPEED PRO offers increased flexibility and impact resistance , allowing printed parts to withstand bending, deformation and sudden mechanical loads more effectively.
High-speed filament with increased toughness
PET HIGH SPEED PRO Clear is an advanced technical filament that combines high-speed printability, excellent impact resistance, minimal warping and a premium high-gloss finish .
Its balanced mechanical properties provide additional flexibility and toughness, making printed parts more resistant to bending, deformation and sudden impacts.
This enables increased productivity without compromising print quality or reliability.
Instead, it retains a strong structural character while providing additional toughness.
PET HIGH SPEED PRO is designed to be exceptionally easy to print .
It combines excellent printability with increased flexibility, high impact resistance, minimal warping and a premium high-gloss finish.
The material is not intended to behave like a very soft or highly flexible filament.
Minimal warping and easy printability
Its very low tendency to warp helps maintain dimensional accuracy, including when printing larger components and geometries where deformation can otherwise become problematic.
Its excellent processing behaviour enables high printing speeds while maintaining consistent extrusion, dimensional accuracy and a high-quality surface finish.
In addition to its mechanical and processing benefits, PET HIGH SPEED PRO produces an attractive high-gloss finish .

claim.text: While conventional rigid materials may crack or break under excessive deformation or sudden impact, PET FLEX MAX is designed to bend and absorb the applied energy.
claim.reason: designed for impact: "PET FLEX MAX is designed to bend and absorb the applied energy" where "conventional rigid materials may crack or break under ... sudden impact".

items.text: Highly flexible filament for tough and impact-resistant parts
This makes it particularly suitable for demanding functional parts that must withstand bending, deformation and sudden impacts while retaining greater structural stability than very soft materials.

This balance makes PET FLEX MAX particularly suitable for protective parts, impact-absorbing components, flexible enclosures, bumpers, protective covers and functional components exposed to sudden loads or repeated deformation during use.
PET FLEX MAX NATURAL is particularly suitable for functional applications where parts must bend under load, absorb sudden impacts and resist breakage .
This makes it suitable for protective enclosures and similar applications, as well as industrial components that are regularly bent, struck or deformed.
Particularly suitable for: Impact-absorbing parts, protective components, flexible enclosures, bumpers, protective covers and functional parts exposed to bending or deformation.
Thanks to minimal warping, easy printability and a wide processing window of 200–300°C , PET FLEX MAX is ideal for demanding functional parts exposed to bending, impact and repeated deformation.
PET FLEX MAX Clear is an advanced technical filament that bridges the gap between conventional rigid materials and very soft flexible filaments.
The result is a material with high flexibility, excellent impact absorption and exceptional resistance to breaking under bending .
While conventional rigid materials may crack or break under excessive deformation or sudden impact, PET FLEX MAX is designed to bend and absorb the applied energy.
PET FLEX MAX can withstand significant deformation without brittle failure.
The result is a tough and flexible technical material for applications where conventional rigid filaments may be too brittle and very soft filaments may provide insufficient stability.
Despite its high flexibility, PET FLEX MAX is designed for easy and reliable 3D printing .
Rather than focusing solely on softness, PET FLEX MAX provides a balanced combination of flexibility and structural stability.
PET FLEX MAX CLEAR is a highly flexible and impact-resistant technical filament.
It combines structural strength with excellent flexibility and impact absorption, producing tough parts that can withstand significant deformation without breaking.
Maximum flexibility
High impact resistance
For applications requiring greater rigidity, a more structurally rigid filament may be preferable.
Combined with its low tendency to warp , PET FLEX MAX makes demanding flexible and impact-resistant parts easier to produce.
This wide processing window makes the filament suitable for various printers, hotends and printing conditions.
The material can be processed within an exceptionally wide temperature range of 200–300°C , including at relatively low printing temperatures.
Advised 3d print speed 150mm/s (12mm³/s)
Cooling fan 100%
High Tg Copolyester (100°C), superior to PETG and PLA
High tensile strength, superior to PETG and ABS
Thanks to Facilan ™ HT superior heat resistance, it enables more durable applications for heat sensitive applications.
Its high strength can optimize 3D designs with low infill for faster print job and thin wall with high rigidity of the parts.
High gloss and shiny surface.
This makes EasyFil PET ideal for 3D printing big objects with fine detail.
3D printing manufacturing aids.
High transparency.
EasyFil PET is as easy to 3D print as regular PLA.
Stronger and more accurate than traditional PETG.
It 3D prints with almost no warping.
This unique set of properties translates to a PET filament that enables you to 3D print accurate parts with improved strength and mechanical properties.
Next to this, EasyFil PET has a higher melting point and lower moisture intake.
Good UV resistance.

items.text: All thermoplastic polyester resins will hydrolyze in hot water. The hydrolysis results in polymer degradation and a decrease in the physical properties of the resin. The rate of hydrolysis depends on exposure conditions; primarily time, temperature and the composition of the specific polyester resin. We recommend that parts made from Rynite should not be used in an environment where there is continuous exposure to water at temperatures above 50 °C.
